scope: fixed public testmini development subset; evidence-block retrieval only

selection.selection: For each published subset choose first 3 unique report names by SHA256(seed+colon+name); union reports; retain every testmini claim for those reports. Frozen before any retrieval metrics.
selection.supersedes: v1 first8 report-only selection omitted knowledge subset; revised for declared coverage before evaluation, not based on scores

model.provenance: Explicit local safetensors directory; local_files_only=True; trust_remote_code=False; token=False
model.query_prefix:
Instruct: Given a financial research question, retrieve relevant passages from company financial reports.
Query:

candidate_policy: Each claim searches ALL blocks of its dataset-assigned full report; all selected reports are encoded; no gold candidate filtering

ranking_protocol.hybrid: equal-weight RRF k=60 over full positive BM25 list and full dense list; no candidate cap

encoding.batch_policy: 8 up to 512 tokens; 4 up to 1024; 2 up to 2048; 1 above 2048; threshold uses first length in contiguous sorted batch

limits: Known source report; discovery is not measured
Whole blocks vary in size; no common character budget
Testmini was used for development; not untouched test performance
No generation, verification verdict, or end-to-end agent score
